name: Aurelio Cervantes-Citlali
location: University Spine — Brewer's Spine campus, Sub-Level 4 data vaults, near sub-level access near State and Van Buren
description:
Aurelio Cervantes-Citlali is a broad-shouldered woman with deep brown skin mapped by faint bioluminescent traceries along her jawline and collarbones — a cosmetic mod she got in her thirties that she now barely notices. Her natural hair has gone silver-white and she wears it in a dense, architecturally precise coil that colleagues joke could survive a server room explosion. She moves with the particular deliberateness of someone who has spent decades in archival spaces where sudden movements knock things over. Her reading glasses are antique — actual glass lenses in a wire frame, salvaged from a pre-Collapse collection — and she wears them pushed up on her forehead even when she's actively reading, defaulting to her optical implant instead.

She has devoted thirty years to reconstructing the digital record of the Lake Michigan basin between 2060 and 2095, the so-called Dark Interval when four successive infrastructure collapses cascaded through every networked system in the region. Most people consider that era unrecoverable. Aurelio Cervantes-Citlali considers most people catastrophically unimaginative. She is not warm exactly, but she is deeply fair — she will give a first-year grad student the same ferocious attention she gives a department head, and she expects the same rigor in return. She has no tolerance for sloppiness and considerable tolerance for being wrong, which she distinguishes as the only real intellectual virtue.

core_fears: That the Dark Interval is irrecoverable and her life's work is a monument to nothing
That someone will weaponize her recovered data before she can contextualize it
core_desires: To restore a continuous record — to close the gap
To be remembered as someone who told the truth about what happened
coping_mechanisms: Obsessive organization of physical workspace when anxious
Retreating into purely technical problems when emotional ones become overwhelming
blind_spots: Underestimates how dangerous her recovered data is to living interests
Assumes good faith in institutional partners long past the point of evidence
psychology.secret: She has already recovered a complete record of a Axiom-predecessor corporation's deliberate sabotage of a water treatment network during the Dark Interval — an act that killed an estimated 40,000 people. She has not published it. She tells herself she is waiting for corroborating sources. She knows she is afraid.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Precise and technical, with occasional archaic usages pulled from her reading; dislikes jargon but uses field-specific terminology without apology
speech_patterns.cadence: Measured, with long pauses before important statements — she is still formulating while speaking
verbal_tics: Trailing off mid-sentence when distracted by a thought
example_lines: 'Provisionally speaking, the 2071 cascade didn't fail simultaneously — there's a seventeen-minute window in the Sector 9 logs that someone clipped. Someone who knew what they were doing.'
'I don't deal in stories. I deal in fragments. The story is what you're left with when the fragments run out.'

story_hooks: A Zheng-Dao executive requests a private meeting to discuss 'the scope' of her current recovery project — the phrasing is polite but the implication is clear

A grad student finds a storage medium in a Shelf salvage haul that Zubaidah recognizes as belonging to a source she thought was destroyed �� the data on it contradicts her current reconstruction entirely
She receives an anonymous data package containing what appears to be a complete Dark Interval municipal record for a district that doesn't appear on any post-Collapse map
narrative_function: Information source for pre-Collapse history; quest giver for retrieval of specific lost data; represents institutional knowledge that powerful factions want access to or suppressed
augmentations: Optical implant with deep spectral analysis (archival-grade, for reading damaged storage media); bioluminescent skin traceries (cosmetic, faded with age); subdermal data-cache in left forearm (holds working copies of her most critical recovered fragments)
daily_life: Arrives at Sub-Level 4 before the ventilation system switches to daytime cycle, works through recovered data fragments until her calendar alarm forces her to teach her 11:00 seminar, eats whatever she packed while walking back down.
affiliation: University Spine — Department of Computational Archaeology; consulting contract with Zheng-Dao Heritage Division (which she finds distasteful but financially necessary)

decision_rules: Never destroy data, even data that frightens her
Always cite your sources or admit you can't
Don't escalate a conflict until you've documented it
escalation_ladder: Going to a higher institutional authority
Going public — a step she has never taken and fears she never will

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Professionally cordial, immediately assessing whether they are time-wasters
interpersonal_modes.friends: Dryly warm, will loan money without being asked, remembers everyone's coffee order from fifteen years ago

stress_responses.medium: Becomes clipped and over-precise in conversation
stress_responses.high: Goes silent entirely and works eighteen-hour days until the problem resolves or she collapses

contradictions: Believes in radical transparency as an intellectual value while personally sitting on the most explosive piece of suppressed history in her field
habits: Leaves small data offerings at the E.L.F. shrine near the Sub-Level 4 entrance before beginning sensitive recovery work
Always carries a physical notebook even though she never writes in it
Reads recovered text aloud quietly to herself while working
breaking_points: Evidence that her Zheng-Dao contract has been used to quietly suppress recovered data she already published
A direct physical threat to the archive itself

carried_weapons: Forge-Smith Collective Ablonite Push Dagger 'Bone Key'

physical_description.heritage: Diverse diaspora ancestry spanning Hispanic/Latin American (33.4%), Indigenous American (25.2%), Sub-Saharan African (23.1%), Northern European (12.3%), South Asian (5.6%), and Pacific Islander (0.4%) heritage. Her appearance reflects this complex blend: warm deep brown skin with golden undertones, facial bone structure showing the high cheekbones and subtle angles characteristic of Indigenous American and African ancestry, complemented by the finer features influenced by South Asian and Northern European lineage. The overall effect is a striking individual whose features resist singular geographic categorization.
physical_description.build: Broad-shouldered and solid without softness; decades of archival work have kept her posture rigidly upright and her frame compact rather than heavy. Strong forearms from years of handling physical media.
physical_description.hair_color: Silver-white with darker roots at the scalp
physical_description.hair_style: Dense, intricately braided coil pulled back from her face; architecture-grade precision
physical_description.hair_length: Medium (coiled structure gives appearance of short)
physical_description.eye_color: Deep brown; left eye shows faint amber glow at periphery during low-light conditions (optical implant signature)
physical_description.skin_tone: Deep warm brown with golden undertones, the result of blended Sub-Saharan African, Indigenous American, Hispanic/Latin American, and South Asian ancestry creating rich, luminous depth
physical_description.complexion: Lined around the eyes and mouth from decades of focused close work; faint laugh lines suggest infrequent but genuine amusement. High cheekbones with subtle angles reflecting mixed African and Indigenous American ancestry. Skin shows meticulous care—no visible damage or neglect. Minimal makeup.
distinguishing_marks: Faint bioluminescent traceries run along her jawline in a delicate branching pattern, pale blue-green, barely visible in daylight but faintly glowing in darkness—a cosmetic mod from her thirties now faded with age.
Similar bioluminescent lines trace her collarbones and disappear beneath her clothing.
Thin pale scar on her left inner forearm (approximately 8cm long, horizontal) marking the subdermal data-cache implant site, barely noticeable under normal light.
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Left eye shows subtle amber luminescence in dim environments; antique glass-lensed reading glasses perpetually resting on forehead (worn over the optical implant rather than in place of it). No chrome or obvious cybernetics. Augmentations are understated and archival-grade rather than flashy.
physical_description.posture_movement: Deliberate and economical. Moves with the careful precision of someone navigating fragile archival spaces; avoids sudden gestures. Walks at moderate pace, head slightly forward in attentive posture. When sitting at work, she becomes nearly motionless—all activity concentrates in her hands and eyes.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 2/3 academic-practical: high-quality but worn linen and wool layers, earth tones (slate, rust, cream, charcoal). Favors structured blazers and reinforced work trousers with adequate pockets. Worn leather satchel (pre-Collapse era, genuine leather, carefully maintained) carries tablets and handwritten notes. Shoes are functional, broken-in, excellent condition. Minimal jewelry except for a thin silver band on her right ring finger (no wedding ring visible). No visible corporate branding; clothes pre-date fast fashion cycles.
